template.description: Path (experiment-relative, or absolute) to the audit TEMPLATE .py — the percent-format module whose section slugs are the required inventory. Checked for: present, parses via parse_percent_source, and git-committed-clean at that path (an uncommitted/dirty template is an 'unsigned template' NO-GO — the commit IS the signature). OMITTED => composed from the bound pack's audit_template seam (the interview's own selection, one definition — run-#12 finding 5); the composed path is echoed on the result, and nothing composable is a loud refusal, never a guess.
template.title: Template

source_roots.description: Opaque import roots (the linked-sources lint's roots). When omitted AND audit_id names an existing audit, defaults from that audit's recorded configuration (the one-declaration rule); otherwise [].
source_roots.title: Source Roots

input_roots.description: Opaque data-path roots (the executes-live lint's roots). When omitted AND audit_id names an existing audit, defaults from that audit's recorded configuration; otherwise [].
input_roots.title: Input Roots

audit_id.description: The caller-authored audit slug. When it names an existing audit its recorded roots default the roots above, and its journal decides resuming-vs-fresh. Omit for a fresh standalone preflight. REQUIRED for the block-drive `audit` chain (P2.b): it is the seat every downstream block is keyed by, so a preflight without one emits no `next_block` and the chain does not start.
audit_id.title: Audit Id

source.description: Experiment-relative path to the audited source .py the loop will lint. Present-and-readable is the DRAFT-READINESS check (P2.b): a GO preflight whose source is absent has nothing to lint yet, so the chain parks for the LLM to draft it (`awaiting_draft`) instead of chaining into a lint that would refuse. Omitted (the default) reads as 'no source yet' — byte-identical to a pre-P2.b preflight in every check, verdict, blocker and brief line.
source.title: Source
